edit.hint.read: Draw a rectangle around a value label. Only that area is reread.
edit.hint.pan: Drag to pan. Wheel or pinch to zoom. Fit shows the whole image.

mech.line_unmeasured: A line could not be measured. Correct its geometry.
mech.circle_unmeasured: A circle could not be measured. Correct its centre and radius.
mech.trace_unmeasured: A link could not be traced. Draw or repair its route.
mech.trajectory_unmeasured: The drawn trajectory could not be measured.
mech.mask_unmeasured: The body mask uses its box. Correct the sprite polygon.
mech.rope_route_assumed: The route around the pulley is inferred. Review the rope and attachments.
mech.angle_mismatch: Printed and measured angles differ by more than five degrees. The printed value was kept.
mech.attachment_invalid: A link needs two distinct valid attachments.
mech.attachment_unreached: A link does not reach its attachment.
mech.rope_route_invalid: The rope does not reach the pulley rim.
mech.invalid_friction: Friction must be nonnegative, with static friction at least kinetic friction.
mech.invalid_link_value: Link length and stiffness must be positive, and damping nonnegative.
mech.invalid_restitution: Restitution must be between zero and one.
mech.unsupported_applied_force: This drawn force is outside the supported solver arrangement. Edit the scene before simulating.
mech.unsupported_incline_orientation: This incline orientation is unsupported. Author an incline rising to the right.
mech.unsupported_spring_orientation: This spring orientation is unsupported. Author its support above or to the left of the body.
mech.multiple_figures: Multiple figures found. The left figure supplies the initial scene; review the panel selection.
mech.collision_check_unmeasured: The after-collision panel could not be checked from readable velocity labels.

mech.regime_slide: The selected friction and angle predict sliding.
mech.regime_stick: The selected static friction and angle predict sticking.
mech.perception_invalid: The measured scene could not be validated. Review the retained objects in edit mode.

mech.time_budget: A stage reached its time budget. Completed evidence was retained; review the partial result.
mech.perspective_skipped: Page corners could not be estimated. The original perspective was kept.

mech.ruling_removed: Faint notebook ruling was removed. Check that the diagram lines remain intact.
mech.low_quality_image: Image quality is low. Check object geometry and label readings.
mech.ocr_unavailable: Local OCR is unavailable. Enter the missing labels and values in edit mode.
